description: Windows intrusion-prevention service that detects failed logins and blocks abusive IP addresses using Windows Firewall.

script: if ($null -eq $asset) { throw 'No stable IPBan Windows x64 ZIP asset was found in the latest release.' }

notes: Review status: the official Windows ZIP distributions are available for x64 and x86. The 4.1.0 SHA-256 digests in this manifest are taken from the official GitHub release API.

The upstream Windows installer extracts IPBan into C:\Program Files\IPBan, changes Windows audit policy settings, creates the IPBan Windows service, and starts it by default. IPBan Free runs as a background service and does not include a standalone GUI.

This staged manifest only downloads the release ZIP. It intentionally defines no service installation, start, stop, or removal hooks and no executable shim or shortcut because the archive layout and a Scoop-safe service lifecycle have not been tested.

Keep this manifest in under review kirobucket until the archive contents, runtime requirements, elevated service registration, configuration/database persistence, upgrade behavior, audit-policy handling, and complete service cleanup on uninstall have been verified.
